Identified as this saint because: Found by listing `Category:Icons of Saint Peter`, the apostle's own Commons icon category, reached from `Category:Saint Peter`. The file's title names the subject outright — «Икона Апостол Пётр», icon of the Apostle Peter — and dates it to the seventeenth century at Pskov, so there is no namesake to confuse it with: this folder IS the apostle, display name «Peter», type `apostle`, kept on 29 June in all four calendars. A single-figure icon, 1969x3000, so nothing has to be read out of a group. Commons describes it: Апостол Петр, со сценами жития апостолов Петра и Павла. Конец XVII в. Псков
